THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Pizza + Leftover Meatballs Dinner

Pizza night, upgraded. Half a Yough! pizza + 5 leftover meatballs in marinara = 665 cal / 55g protein per adult in 20 minutes.

YIELD2 servings
TOTAL TIME20 min (pizza bake + meatball reheat)
COOK METHODOven
EST. / SERVING~665 cal | ~55g protein

Ingredients

ADULT PLATE (per person)

  • 1/2 Yough! Mozzarella Cheese Pizza (or any thin frozen mozzarella pizza)
  • 5 Lean Beef Meatballs (from the 30-piece cookbook base)
  • 1/4 cup thick marinara, warmed

KID PLATE (per kid, appetite-driven)

  • 1 Costco single-serve pizza
  • 2-3 Lean Beef Meatballs, warmed in marinara
  • Small side of marinara for dipping

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten.

Method

  1. 1.PREHEAT + COOK PIZZAS. Bake the Yough! (or your frozen mozzarella pizza) per the package directions. Costco single-serve pizzas can go in the same oven side-by-side if timing matches.
  2. 2.REHEAT MEATBALLS IN MARINARA. In a covered saucepan on the stovetop, warm 10 meatballs (5 per adult) with 1/2 cup marinara over medium heat 5-7 min until steaming through. Or microwave covered 60-90 sec per plate.
  3. 3.PLATE ADULTS. Halve the baked Yough! pizza. Each adult plate gets 1/2 pizza + 5 meatballs + 1/4 cup marinara.
  4. 4.PLATE KIDS. One Costco single-serve pizza per kid. Add 2-3 meatballs with a spoon of marinara — portion by appetite. Extra marinara on the side for dipping.

Storage and reheating

Store: Meatballs + marinara: refrigerated up to 3-4 days. Pizza: bake fresh from frozen — don't rebake.

Reheat: Meatballs + marinara: covered saucepan 5-7 min or microwave 60-90 sec covered. Pizza: bake per package.

Lasts: Leftover baked pizza reheats OK but loses crispness. Meatballs hold 4 days fridge / 2 months freezer per the meatball base.

Brands I use

Yough!
Mozzarella Cheese Pizza (thin crust, label reads 660 cal / 40g protein per full pizza)
Higher-protein thin frozen mozzarella pizza. 1/2 pizza per adult keeps the plate at ~330 cal / 20g protein before the meatballs. Any thin frozen mozzarella pizza works — recalculate from the current label.
Costco
Single-serve cheese pizzas (multi-pack)
The kid vessel. Familiar format, single-portion sizing, no cutting.
Lean Beef Meatballs (30-piece Base)
The cookbook base — 5 meatballs = 285 cal / 34g protein
The leftover-play that turns pizza night into a 55g-protein dinner. Assumes you baked the base earlier in the week.
Rao's or any thick marinara
1/2 cup total to reheat the meatballs
Thick jarred marinara — thin sauces run off the meatballs on the plate. Rao's is the tested option; store-brand thick marinara works.
